title: Eternal Prism
description: Vibrant water, night aurora, swaying foliage and soft shadows — lightweight Iris shader.
body:
# Eternal Prism

A cinematic Iris shader that makes Minecraft feel alive — volumetric light, 3D clouds, living water and a night sky worth staring at. Scales from low-end PCs to cinematic ultra.

## Features

### Light & Atmosphere
- **Volumetric light** — real light shafts through trees and terrain
- **Soft shadows (PCSS)** — shadows blur naturally with distance
- **Two-tone lighting** — warm sunlight, cool sky ambient
- **Height-based ground fog** — morning mist settles in valleys
- **Aerial perspective** — distant terrain fades into the sky

### Sky
- **Volumetric 3D clouds** with self-shadowing (SUPER_HIGH/ULTRA)
- **Milky Way, nebulae and twinkling stars** at night
- **Aurora borealis** — procedural, different every night
- **Golden sunsets** with time-of-day color grading

### Water
- **Gerstner waves** — physically-shaped, animated
- **Screen-space reflections** — water mirrors the world
- **Caustics, foam and subtle rainbow iridescence** (it is a prism, after all)

### World
- **Swaying foliage** — leaves, grass and flowers react to wind
- **Wet surfaces in rain** — blocks darken and shine
- **Cinematic post-processing** — bloom, DoF, film grain, ACES tone mapping

## Fully customizable — 26 options
Toggle every effect individually and tune brightness, saturation, contrast, wave height, fog density and more — right from Shader Options. No reinstall needed.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.x
- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)

## Installation
1. Download the .zip
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/shaderpacks/` (no need to unzip)
3. Options → Video Settings → Shader Packs → **Eternal Prism**
4. Click the gear icon to open Shader Options

Feedback and bug reports are very welcome!
